text:
Anya: heads up — after the telemetry-proxy rollout this morning a bunch of metric tiles on the main dashboard are hanging on initial load. Repro: open /dashboards/overview, expand 'Active Routes' tile, the spinner never resolves for ~30% of requests.
Mike: seeing same on canary, only in EU region. timeline shows long parse time in the browser.
Anya: attaching a short console snippet i grabbed from the hung tab:```
telemetry-client.js:245 Uncaught RangeError: Invalid array length
at parseTelemetryPayload (telemetry-client.js:245)
at handleBatch (telemetry-client.js:312)
```
Sanjay: that stack points at the new compressed batch code we merged yesterday (viz-telemetry v3.2). Could be the decompression path hitting corrupt chunk metadata.
Olivia: if it's the v3.2 path we should toggle the runtime flag that disables compressed batches. Can somebody run a hot rollback on the client flag? @deploy-bot any way to flip without full deploy?
deploy-bot: canary flag toggles available: `feature.telemetry.compressed_batches` -> set to `false` for console-eu-canary. Applying now.
Mike: flag flipped, canary shows immediate improvement — the hung tiles are loading. Looks like compressed_batches is the culprit.
Anya: confirmed on prod-canary after rolling flag there too. Spike in bundle parse time correlated with compressed batches unpack loop.
Sanjay: will open a revert PR for viz-telemetry v3.2, but we should also add defensive checks. Minimal quickfix idea: guard against bogus chunk sizes before allocating arrays (fail gracefully and drop the batch).
Olivia: also we should patch the client to avoid blocking critical paint on telemetry parsing. If a batch parse exceeds 50ms, schedule parsing in a microtask/worker and render immediately.
Mike: agree. short term: keep compressed_batches off for all regions until fix + canary validation. I can push a config roll this afternoon.
Anya: thanks. I'll add a dashboard alert to detect >5% tile load stalls so SRE sees it if it regresses. Also adding a small repro harness (recorded payload that triggers the error) to the PR so we don't reintroduce.
Sanjay: PR #1124 opened for revert + defensive checks, linking the repro artifact.
Olivia: plan: (1) keep flag off, (2) revert v3.2, (3) patch to async-parse, (4) re-enable behind flag with canary.
Mike: ping me when canary is green and I'll run perf delta on bundle+parse times.
Anya: thanks all — saved us from wider UX outage. :thumbsup:
